preconditions.description: The number of operations of adding a vertex is between 1 and 10^5, inclusive.
The number of edges to be added for the i-th operation is between 0 and i - 1, inclusive.
Each vertex vj in the edge description is between 1 and i - 1, inclusive.
The weight xj of each edge is between -10^9 and 10^9, inclusive.
The sum of all k across all operations does not exceed 10^5.

postconditions.expression: output == sum(weight of all edges in the resulting graph) % 1000000007
postconditions.description: The output is the sum of the weights of all edges in the resulting graph modulo 1000000007.
